headlineCard.description: {label} is a community market index that aggregates TCG card prices (Pokémon, One Piece) traded on French-speaking platforms. The methodology is public and the data is transparent. This index reflects the state of the market in real time, weighted by transaction volume and the number of tracked constituents.

sealedEv.description: Compares each Booster Box's price to the loose (ungraded) value of its singles. A comparative signal between sets, not a guaranteed expected gain — a high ratio can come from a single very rare card, not a globally rich set.

undervalued.title: Undervalued Cards
undervalued.description: Cards trading below their structural pull cost, weighted by character popularity. A ratio > 1 means the market price is below what it statistically costs to open that card from a pack — a potential buying signal.
undervalued.methodology: theoretical_value = pull_cost × character_multiplier. pull_cost = pack_price / pull_rate (derived from set structure). undervalued_score = theoretical_value / market_price. MVP: collector & demand factors fixed at 1.0.
undervalued.emptyDescription: The undervalued score calculation hasn't run yet, or no card matches the current filters.

gradingRoi.title: Grading ROI Calculator
gradingRoi.description: Compares an ungraded card's price plus PSA submission cost to its expected value once graded — weighted by that specific card's own grade odds, not just an optimistic PSA10 price.
gradingRoi.methodology: expected_value = Σ P(grade) × price(grade), where P(grade) comes from the card's own mix of graded sales (falls back to same-rarity cards in the set, then the whole set, then TCG-wide when there aren't enough sales). Grades below PSA 7 aren't tracked by any of our sources — that risk is a manual assumption, not a measurement. PSA fees shown are indicative tiers, all editable per submission.
gradingRoi.emptyDescription: No card currently has both an ungraded price and at least one graded price to compute from.

divergence.title: Volume/Price Divergence
divergence.description: Compares two time windows of equal length (current vs previous period) on a card's number of sales and average price. A price rising while volume falls (or the reverse) is a less confirmed move than one where both go the same direction.
divergence.methodology: divergence = price_change(%) − volume_change(%) between the current window and the previous window of equal length. Only ungraded sales are counted (mixing grades would skew the average) and only cards with at least 3 sales in each of the two windows are included -- otherwise the delta isn't reliable (e.g. 1 sale vs 2 sales would show +100% while meaning nothing).
divergence.emptyDescription: Not enough sales in the selected windows to compute a reliable divergence -- try a longer window.

liquidity.title: Liquidity
liquidity.description: Sell-through rate: how much of this card actually sold recently (30-day sales) versus how much is still listed on eBay. Not an order book (eBay only has asking prices, no buy-side depth) -- a stock-pressure signal, retail/resale style.
liquidity.methodology: sell-through rate = sales_30d / (sales_30d + active_listings). Current scope: EN sealed only, recent sets, and only items with both an eBay snapshot and at least one sale in the last 90 days. One Piece restricted to Booster Box (other sealed formats aren't comparable to each other).
liquidity.emptyDescription: No item currently has both active eBay listings and recent sales.
